clips.title: The story
paras: A cask of Rejold Barleybrew’s new Shimmer Stout is bound for Mountaineer Kadrell in Loch Modan. You carry the brew from Dun Morogh’s frozen heights to the warmer valley.

Mountaineer Barleybrew thinks Rejold’s new Shimmer Stout is too good to keep in Dun Morogh. From the eastern border post, he watches over the mountain passes and the kin guarding neighboring lands. The Mountaineers’ patrols can be cold and grueling, and a stout heart calls for stout drink. Barleybrew wants an honest opinion from a fellow patrolman, so he sends a cask east with travelers bound for Loch Modan.

For young dwarven and gnomish adventurers, the road to Loch Modan is a rite of passage after their early days in Dun Morogh’s snowbound crags. You pass southeast through the South Gate Outpost and follow long tunnels cut through the mountain bedrock. Beyond them lies Loch Modan’s warmer, wooded basin. Mountaineer Kadrell patrols the road through Thelsamar. He gladly pauses to tap the cask and finds that Barleybrew’s new recipe has an astonishing kick.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I've been drinking more of that Shimmer Stout my brother made - it's great stuff! I want a fellow Mountaineer to try it. His name's Kadrell, and he's usually patrolling the road through Thelsamar in Loch Modan.
To get to Thelsamar, go southeast through the tunnel, then turn northeast when the path forks into a road. Follow that road straight into Thelsamar.
Give Mountaineer Kadrell this cask of Shimmer Stout and see what he thinks!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings, Shaman, and welcome to Thelsamar!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Now, let me have a taste...
Magni's Beard! This stuff gets your head turning! And it lightens the limbs, too.
I feel like I can fly!
